tools.name: loket_get_user
tools.description: Return the Loket user behind the access token: personal details, contact information and role. Loket API: GET /v2/user.

tools.name: loket_list_employers
tools.description: List the employers this user can access (companies, with their ids). Start here to get an employer_id. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers.

tools.name: loket_get_employer
tools.description: Return one employer: company name, address, chamber of commerce number, legal form and settings. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}.

tools.name: loket_list_payroll_administrations
tools.description: List the payroll administrations of an employer (their name, period type and start and end date). Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}/payrolladministrations.

tools.name: loket_get_payroll_administration
tools.description: Return one payroll administration with its address, client number and payroll period type. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}.

tools.name: loket_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments of an employer, with their codes and descriptions. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}/departments.

tools.name: loket_list_national_holidays
tools.description: List the national holidays that apply to an employer. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}/nationalholidays.

tools.name: loket_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of an employer: names, employee number and status. Contains personal data. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}/employees.

tools.name: loket_get_employee
tools.description: Return one employee: personal details, address and contact information. Contains personal data. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/employees/{employeeId}.

tools.name: loket_list_absences
tools.description: List the absences (sick leave, leave and similar) of one employee. Contains health-related data. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/employees/{employeeId}/absences.

tools.name: loket_get_absence
tools.description: Return one absence with its cause, expected duration and progress. Contains health-related data. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/employees/absences/{absenceId}.

tools.name: loket_list_workflows
tools.description: List the workflows of an employer (leave requests, contract changes and similar), with status, initiator and dates. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}/workflows.

tools.name: loket_get_workflow
tools.description: Return one workflow with its status, current task and comments. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/workflows/{workflowId}.
